subject: Broker will not start after upgrade
body: I installed Quillbus 3.2 on our server running Java 11 and the broker exits immediately with UnsupportedClassVersionError. What is wrong?

subject: Address already in use on 5672
body: Starting the broker fails with 'Address already in use: 5672'. Nothing else of ours should use that port. How do I fix it?

subject: Clients refused during peak traffic
body: During our evening peak new clients get CONNECTION_REFUSED: limit reached. We have around 1500 clients. Which setting do I change?

subject: Disk keeps filling up
body: Our disk fills up every few days and publishers get blocked. We set retention.hours to 0 last month to keep everything. Could that be the cause?

subject: Consumers stall, queue growing
body: Our consumers stop receiving messages and the queue depth keeps growing. The management console shows many unacked messages on one connection.

subject: Publishing became very slow
body: Publish throughput dropped to a fraction after we enabled sync_publish. Is that expected and what can we do?

subject: TLS_KEY_TOO_WEAK with our ECDSA certificate
body: After enabling TLS the broker refuses to start with TLS_KEY_TOO_WEAK although our certificate uses an ECDSA P-256 key. We run version 3.1.

subject: Connection limit ignored after upgrading to 3.0
body: We upgraded to 3.0 and our max_conn setting from the old config no longer limits connections. Nothing is logged.

subject: Cluster split after network outage
body: After a network outage between racks half of our three node cluster stopped accepting clients. Is this a bug?

subject: How do I configure LDAP authentication?
body: We want users to log in to the management console with our company LDAP server. Where is this configured and which attributes are supported?

subject: Kubernetes operator for Quillbus
body: Is there an official Helm chart or operator to deploy Quillbus on Kubernetes? We need autoscaling support.

subject: Heap setting and OOM kills
body: The Linux OOM killer terminates the broker every few days. QB_HEAP is set to 15g on a 16 GB machine.
